candidate_exposure: None. Root read only pinned current original schema, evaluator and documented workflow before this freeze.
purpose: Make the maintained external-evaluation workflow usable by preparing exact source-bound, explicitly unavailable prediction rows; no inference or new evaluation grammar.

contracts.relevant_section: External predictions; exact-file digests, every window/target, exact signed-int64 timestamps and null for unavailable values.

independent_fixture.timestamp_encoding: Strings here preserve exact fixture intent across tool JSON transports. Construct signed-int64 source Parquet and emit JSON integer tokens, never strings/floats.

expected_template.modelId: preserve caller label exactly after existing admission
expected_template.windowsSha256: Independent SHA256 of the complete selected windows.parquet bytes
expected_template.manifestSha256: Independent SHA256 of the complete final selected manifest.json bytes, not its embedded preimage/self entry
expected_template.predictions: Exactly three rows in Parquet order w2,w0,w9, preserving each exact signed-int64 timestamp; each values object has exactly both targets, both JSON null.

cases.expect: Invoke the new actual CLI on the exact native producer bundle, inspect its real file, and feed that unchanged file through the maintained external evaluator. Preserve producer/evaluator/schema and all input bytes. Document if only a private admission helper, rather than the user-facing evaluation workflow, is received.
Include valid and invalid windows in original row order. No filtered/sorted/reindexed windows; no teacher value, zero estimate, score, model output or success claim appears in the template.
Use the independent fixture to prove 2^53+1, -1 and signed-int64 maximum remain exact JSON integer values and are admitted unchanged by the maintained evaluator.

For the three finite-teacher fixture rows, each target has n=0, MAE/RMSE/Pearson null, insufficient_pairs, excluded invalidWindow=1/nonfiniteTeacher=0/missingPrediction=2. Evaluation may succeed structurally but must not imply a model was run or accurate.

Exact bytes, including manifest whitespace/newline changes, determine digests. Old embedded preimage digest is never copied as final manifestSha256. Swapped or changed windows/manifest must be refused through the unchanged evaluator admission before final publication.

Bind the actual selected package session via its maintained reader/summary route, not by trusting the bundle's own sessionIds as the independent expected session. Refuse missing/out-of-package bundle job and wrong-session manifest using maintained admission.
Malformed UTF8/JSON, duplicate JSON keys, nonfinite JSON tokens, wrong manifest schema, mismatched windows digest, or missing final files refuse without final output.
Duplicate/empty/foreign-type window IDs, empty windows, missing columns, floating/Boolean/missing/out-of-int64 timestamps refuse under the maintained evaluator's rules.

Preserve the existing required nonempty/distinct target list, numeric registered target membership and numeric column dtype; refuse missing/duplicate/unknown targets, Boolean/string teacher columns or invalid/missing Boolean validity. Do not invent stricter target normalization.
Preserve accepted Unicode and surrounding spaces exactly; reject blank/nonstring/over120/control-character labels using the existing evaluator contract. No inferred or authenticated model identity.
An existing regular file, directory, live/dangling symlink or source alias is refused before any replacement. Exact existing bytes, link identity and other source files remain unchanged.

A destination created after the early check must remain untouched. Failed serialization/admission/close/publication leaves no new final partial JSON. Clean only temporary state owned by this attempt; do not modify shared job metadata.

Respect the maintained 64MiB per-input file admission, including the authored prediction file, before final publication. Do not describe that file-size bound as a bound on decompressed Parquet memory or total process resources.

Same admitted source bytes and exact label produce identical JSON bytes, without wall-clock fields. Publish one ordinary editable JSON file. No schema changes, generated teacher predictions, sidecar, model download or network request.

CLI help/doc shows select bundle/model label, create new template, fill nulls, run the existing evaluator. The completion message plainly states values are unavailable placeholders. Preserve existing run_analysis, job APIs, evaluator and producer bytes.

review_limits: This frozen packet specifies independently derived consumer expectations, not executed tests or a source approval. Author must retain native source/receipts and any departures or failed controls. Additional implementation discoveries must be recorded explicitly.
